FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Can I combine services?

Yes. Many clients combine social media management with ads, or a new website with Google Maps optimization. We quote the combination you need.

What currency are your prices in?

In US dollars (USD), with a written quote before any work starts.

Do you offer e-commerce and branding?

Yes. Online stores start from $2,500 and logos from $350. Both are part of our web development service.

Not sure where to start?

Request a free consultation. We will tell you which service makes sense first for your business, or call +1 (617) 386-9074.
